tools.name: wufoo_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms the API key's user can access: name, description, hash (permanent identifier), URL title, public/private, start/end dates, entry limit, created/updated timestamps. Set includeTodayCount to add EntryCountToday. Wufoo: GET /forms.json.

tools.name: wufoo_get_form
tools.description: Fetch one form's settings by hash or URL title — name, description, confirmation message, notification emails, public flag, language, start/end dates, entry limit and links. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}.json.

tools.name: wufoo_get_form_fields
tools.description: The field structure of a form: each field's Title, Type, API ID (Field###, used for filters, sorting and submissions), required flag, default value and page. Checkbox, name, address and likert fields list SubFields with their own IDs; multiple-choice, dropdown and likert fields list Choices. Admin-o

tools.name: wufoo_list_form_entries
tools.description: List a form's submitted entries (as in the Entry Manager), keyed by field API ID (Field105…) plus EntryId, DateCreated, CreatedBy, DateUpdated, UpdatedBy. Filter like the Entry Manager (Filter1=Field105 Contains foo, combined with match AND/OR), sort by any field ID, and page with pageStart/pageSize

tools.name: wufoo_get_labeled_entries
tools.description: Fetch a page of a form's entries with every Field### key replaced by the field's human title — e.g. "Email", or "Title — Label" for sub-fields of checkbox, name, address and likert fields ("Name — First", "Address — City"). EntryId, DateCreated and the other default/system keys stay as they are. Emp

tools.name: wufoo_count_form_entries
tools.description: Count a form's entries — all of them, or only those matching filters (same filter format as wufoo_list_form_entries). Useful to plan paging. Returns {EntryCount}. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/entries/count.json.

tools.name: wufoo_list_form_comments
tools.description: List the comments team members left on a form's entries in the Entry Manager: CommentId, EntryId, Text, CommentedBy, DateCreated. Optionally only for one entry. Page with pageStart/pageSize (max 100). Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/comments.json.

tools.name: wufoo_count_form_comments
tools.description: Count all comments on a form's entries. Returns {Count}. Wufoo: GET /forms/{identifier}/comments/count.json.

tools.name: wufoo_list_reports
tools.description: List the reports the API key's user can access: name, description, hash, URL title, public flag and created/updated timestamps. Wufoo: GET /reports.json.

tools.name: wufoo_get_report
tools.description: Fetch one report by hash or URL title. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}.json.

tools.name: wufoo_get_report_fields
tools.description: The field structure of the form a report is built on (same shape as wufoo_get_form_fields). Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/fields.json.

tools.name: wufoo_list_report_entries
tools.description: The entries that make up a report — what its datagrid widget or an export would show, keyed by field API ID. Wufoo documents no paging or filter parameters for this endpoint. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/entries.json.

tools.name: wufoo_count_report_entries
tools.description: Count the entries in a report. Returns {EntryCount}. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/entries/count.json.

tools.name: wufoo_list_report_widgets
tools.description: The chart, graph (pie/bar/line) and big-number widgets on a report: Name, Type, TypeDesc, Size and Hash (the hash embeds the widget). Text and datagrid widgets are not returned. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/widgets.json.

tools.name: wufoo_list_users
tools.description: List the account's users: name, email, timezone, company, owner/admin flags and create-forms/reports/themes permissions. Each user's API key is redacted from the result. Wufoo: GET /users.json.

tools.name: wufoo_submit_entry
tools.description: WRITE: submits a new entry to a form, exactly as if someone filled it in — it is stored and triggers the form's notifications, webhooks and integrations. Keys are field API IDs from wufoo_get_form_fields (Field1, Field105…); fields with sub-fields (name, address, checkbox) take one key per sub-field

tools.name: wufoo_add_webhook
tools.description: WRITE: adds a webhook to a form, so Wufoo POSTs every new entry to the given URL. Idempotent per URL: calling again with the same URL updates its handshake key / metadata setting instead of adding a duplicate. Forms allow at most 10 integrations. Returns WebHookPutResult.Hash — keep it, it is needed

tools.name: wufoo_delete_webhook
tools.description: WRITE: removes a webhook from a form; the receiving URL stops getting new entries immediately. Needs the webhook hash returned by wufoo_add_webhook (Wufoo has no endpoint to list webhooks). Wufoo: DELETE /forms/{identifier}/webhooks/{webhookHash}.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wufoo_list_forms, wufoo_get_form, wufoo_get_labeled_entries, wufoo_list_form_comments, wufoo_count_form_comments, wufoo_list_reports, wufoo_get_report, wufoo_list_users, wufoo_delete_webhook · Private data: wufoo_list_forms, wufoo_list_reports, wufoo_list_report_entries, wufoo_list_users · Public sink: wufoo_get_labeled_entries, wufoo_list_users, wufoo_submit_entry, wufoo_add_webhook, wufoo_delete_webhook · Destructive: wufoo_count_form_entries, wufoo_add_webhook, wufoo_delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wufoo_list_forms, wufoo_get_form, wufoo_get_labeled_entries, wufoo_list_form_comments, wufoo_count_form_comments, wufoo_list_reports, wufoo_get_report, wufoo_list_users, wufoo_delete_webhook · Private data: wufoo_list_forms, wufoo_list_reports, wufoo_list_report_entries, wufoo_list_users · Public sink: wufoo_get_labeled_entries, wufoo_list_users, wufoo_submit_entry, wufoo_add_webhook, wufoo_delete_webhook · Destructive: wufoo_count_form_entries, wufoo_add_webhook, wufoo_delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
